clause: origin of PF00110 HOG on stem(Metazoa)
pass_rule: recovered iff (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF00110) has origin on stem(Metazoa); AND (b) hit(PF00110) occurs in <=2 species of outside(Metazoa) (leak tolerance).

clause: origin of PF00019 HOG on stem(Metazoa)
pass_rule: recovered iff (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF00019) has origin on stem(Metazoa); AND (b) hit(PF00019) occurs in <=2 species of outside(Metazoa). PF00688 (TGFb_propeptide) is reported by the same rules but is NOT required for recovery.

clause: origin of PF01049 HOG on stem(Metazoa)
pass_rule: recovered iff (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF01049) has origin on stem(Metazoa); AND (b) hit(PF01049) occurs in <=2 species of outside(Metazoa).

clause: PF00028 HOG origin at or above Choanozoa, present at Choanozoa
pass_rule: recovered iff >=1 PF-HOG(PF00028) satisfies ALL: (a) origin(H) is P(Metazoa) or an ancestor of it (NOT on stem(Metazoa)); (b) present_at(P(Metazoa)); (c) >=1 member from Metazoa; (d) >=1 member protein from a non-metazoan Filozoa species (Choanoflagellata or Filasterea).

clause: (a) SH2+PK_Tyr architecture per species; (b) PF00102 HOG present at Choanozoa
pass_rule: recovered iff ALL: (a) architecture PF00017+PF07714 (SH2 before PK_Tyr_Ser-Thr) occurs in >=1 protein of Metazoa, in >=1 protein of a Choanoflagellata species, and in >=1 protein of a Filasterea species; (b) >=1 PF-HOG(PF00102) has present_at(P(Metazoa)) with >=1 member from Metazoa and >=1 member from a non-metazoan Filozoa species.

clause: PF00362 HOG origin >= Apusomonadida+Opisthokonta; lost on Fungi and Choanoflagellata stems
pass_rule: recovered iff >=1 PF-HOG(PF00362) H satisfies ALL: (a) origin(H) is MRCA(Opisthokonta, Apusomonadida) or older, and H has >=1 member from Thecamonas trahens; (b) loss on stem(Fungi) for H; (c) loss on stem(Choanoflagellata) for H.

what_is_tested: presence + stem loss + stem duplication (deep node)
clause: PF00907 HOG present at Holozoa; lost on Choanoflagellata stem; duplicated on Metazoa stem
pass_rule: recovered iff ALL: (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF00907) H has present_at(crown(Holozoa)) and >=1 member from a non-metazoan Holozoa species (Ichthyosporea or Filasterea) and >=1 member from Metazoa; (b) loss on stem(Choanoflagellata) for H; (c) >=1 duplication on stem(Metazoa) in any PF-HOG(PF00907).

clause: DSL and NOD/NODP HOGs present at Choanozoa with metazoan + choanoflagellate members
pass_rule: recovered iff BOTH: (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF01414) is present_at(P(Metazoa)) with >=1 member from Metazoa and >=1 member from a Choanoflagellata species; (b) >=1 PF-HOG(PF06816 or PF07684) is present_at(P(Metazoa)) with >=1 member from Metazoa and >=1 member from a Choanoflagellata species.

clause: PF05920 HOG present at each of three P nodes with a member in M
pass_rule: recovered iff, for each of the three P nodes (P of Streptophyta M1, P of Phaeophyceae S->X, P of Rhodophyta M1, as defined in data/transitions.tsv) there is >=1 PF-HOG(PF05920) H with present_at(P) AND >=1 member in the corresponding multicellular clade (Streptophyta M1 clade; Phaeophyceae; Eurhodophytina). All three required.

clause: origin of PF03514 HOG on stem(Anydrophyta) + outside-hit check
pass_rule: recovered iff ALL: (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF03514) has origin on stem(Zygnematophyceae+Embryophyta); (b) hit(PF03514) occurs in <=2 species of outside(Zygnematophyceae+Embryophyta); (c) the best DIAMOND hit (e<=1e-5, by bitscore) of >=1 representative per gained HOG, searched against all euk plus prokaryote-run proteomes with the clade itself excluded, lies in a bacterial proteome. If no bacterial or other outside hit passes e<=1e-5, (c) is not_evaluable and the control is scored on (a) and (b) with a flag.

what_is_tested: origin at/above P (no gain on stem)
clause: PF01858/PF01857 HOG origin at/above P, present at P
pass_rule: recovered iff >=1 PF-HOG(PF01858 or PF01857) H satisfies ALL: (a) H has >=1 member from Chlamydomonas reinhardtii; (b) present_at(P) for each of the two Volvocales primary transitions (P nodes in data/transitions.tsv); (c) origin(H) is P or an ancestor (no gain on either Volvocales stem); (d) H has >=1 member in Volvox carteri.
recovered iff n(V. carteri f. nagariensis) >= 2 * n(C. reinhardtii) AND n(V. carteri) - n(C. reinhardtii) >= 5, where n = number of proteins with hit(PF12499) in the final proteome.

Let H_hex be the HOG containing N. crassa Hex1, identified by reciprocal best DIAMOND hit to the published Hex1 sequence (fallback: Aspergillus nidulans HexA). recovered iff EITHER (i) H_hex is not the HOG containing N. crassa eIF5A, origin(H_hex)=crown(Pezizomycotina), and >=90% of its member species are Pezizomycotina (<=2 outside species); OR (ii) H_hex contains N. crassa eIF5A, has >=1 duplication on stem(Pezizomycotina), median member count per Pezizomycotina species >=2 and median per Taphrinomycotina species <=1.

clause: PF01185 median per species, Agaricomycetes vs other Dikarya
pass_rule: recovered iff BOTH: (a) median per-species n(hit(PF01185)) in sampled Agaricomycetes >= max(3, 2 * median per-species n in sampled non-Agaricomycetes Dikarya); (b) n(hit(PF01185)) = 0 in every sampled Saccharomycotina species (leak tolerance applies: at most 1 species with hits).

what_is_tested: null: no expansion of stem duplications
clause: share of stem-duplicated HOGs in toolkit classes on the fungal-hyphae stem
pass_rule: recovered iff, for each of the three toolkit classes (kinase_ptyr, adhesion_ecm, signalling; data/toolkit_pfam.tsv, members only), the H5/H6-style statistic on the fungal hyphae stem (share of stem duplications falling in class HOGs) is NOT called an expansion; an expansion is called iff empirical upper-tail percentile >=0.95 against the matched control branches (DESIGN 4.1) AND observed/expected >=1.5.

clause: PF00109+PF00698 architecture per species, Dictyostelia vs other Amoebozoa
pass_rule: recovered iff median per-species n(proteins with architecture PF00109+PF00698) in sampled Dictyostelia >= 10 AND >= 2 * median per-species n in sampled non-Dictyostelia Amoebozoa (genome-based species only; all if fewer than 2).
